subject: New billing contact at Cobalt Freight
text:
Hi all,

I wanted to let you know that I'm moving into a new role on our pricing team at the end of the month. Starting December 1, your billing contact at Cobalt Freight will be Jasmine Ortega (jortega@cobaltfreight.com, 614-555-0122). Jasmine will handle invoice questions, statements, and payment follow-ups.

Nothing else is changing on the billing side. It's been a pleasure working with you!

Angela Pruitt
Billing Coordinator
